message:
## Vulnerability Digest

Two credible, newly published vulnerabilities matched the deduplicated primary product inventory in the last 24 hours. Both are rated High and warrant prompt version review.

**Scope:** `Products.txt` and `List_of_SIA_Completed.txt` only. Obvious aliases and duplicate rows were normalized; headings, blank rows, and clearly administrative project text were excluded. `DLL_software_component.txt` was not read or combined.

**Scan window:** 2026-10-31 05:10 IST through 2026-11-01 05:10 IST (2026-10-30 23:40 UTC through 2026-10-31 23:40 UTC).

### Finding 1 — WordPress Core upgrade-window remote code execution

- **Product:** WordPress Core
- **Issue:** CVE-2026-119977
- **Severity:** High, CVSS 3.1 score 8.1 (Wordfence CNA)
- **Published:** 2026-10-31 05:33 UTC
- **Description:** Predictable, web-accessible staging paths used during full-package core upgrades can allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute code during the upgrade window. The CVE record covers affected release branches from WordPress 4.7 through 7.1.3; WordPress 7.1.4 contains the referenced correction.
- **Why relevant:** WordPress is explicitly present in the monitored product list.
- **Sources:** [CVE record](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-119977), [WordPress 7.1.4 release](https://wordpress.org/news/2026/10/wordpress-7-1-4/)

### Finding 2 — Visual Studio certificate-validation spoofing

- **Product:** Microsoft Visual Studio
- **Issue:** CVE-2026-118147
- **Severity:** High, CVSS 3.1 score 7.4 (Microsoft)
- **Published:** 2026-10-31 18:13 UTC
- **Description:** Improper certificate validation can allow an unauthenticated network attacker to perform spoofing. Microsoft lists Visual Studio 2017 15.9 before 15.9.84, Visual Studio 2019 16.11 before 16.11.62, Visual Studio 2022 17.14 before 17.14.44, and Visual Studio 2026 18.11 before 18.11.3 as affected.
- **Why relevant:** Visual Studio is explicitly present in both the primary inventory and the completed-SIA list.
- **Source:** [Microsoft Security Response Center](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-118147)

### MongoDB ecosystem verification

The mandatory dedicated sweep covered MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, official drivers and major libraries, connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations, MongoDB-owned notices, CVE/NVD-linked records, GitHub Security Advisories, and CISA sources. [MongoDB's security alert catalog](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts) showed no MongoDB-family advisory published in this exact window; its newest visible entries were dated October 13, 2026.

### Possible matches needing review

None.

### Review priority

Prompt review is recommended for internet-facing WordPress deployments and affected Visual Studio installations because both retained findings are rated High and directly match the monitored inventory. No other candidate passed all freshness, product-match, source-credibility, and deduplication checks.
